checkpointClasses.readiness: before implementation: validate dependencies, scope, architecture version, authority preservation and assurance profile
checkpointClasses.work_order: before execution: validate Work Order completeness, proof contract, migration reservation, tenant/security impact and allowed surfaces
checkpointClasses.pr_conformance: at PR: evaluate exact implementation revision against architecture assertions, transformations and forbidden shortcuts
checkpointClasses.verification_entry: before terminal verification/release: require applicable evidence and exact revision identity
checkpointClasses.fitness: for material changes or scheduled evaluation: assess declared quality attributes against measured baselines/thresholds
checkpointClasses.release: for applicable high-risk changes: require release strategy, operational evidence and rollback/post-release validation

commonRules: revision-bound where implementation content is evaluated
tenant mismatch is rejected before content access
checkpoint orchestration does not mutate workflow state directly
